hook: Your airport train in Shanghai floats.
title: Your Airport Train Floats at 430 km/h
description:
Shanghai's maglev airport train floats above its track using magnets, so there are no wheels rolling on rails. On a commercial run it reaches about 430 km/h. Part of the Tech That Sounds Fake series.

#Shorts #Maglev #TechFacts
comment_prompt: Would you ride it? Yes or no
hook_banner: TRAIN WITH NO WHEELS ON TRACK
